title: two layers drifting, the kick and the snare into the moire
story: Back On 74 at a 146 BPM snare cadence (a snare every 26.3 ticks, two beats) with a kick and a thinner groove under it. The moire is a hook: two layers drift slowly at a mid paso, and the fringes are read from the kick (contraste 2.2->3.4, zoom punch 1.0->1.5) and the snare (grosor thins 0.32->0.16 with a col_bri lift). Every two beats the fringes re-form (separacion alternates +-0.1), and each bar moves the palette a step. At the harmonic change 3371 (RMS -0.61 sd, chroma turning) the fringes bend: curva runs to 0.5 over two bars, the hue steps warmer, one layer shifts, the room closes. After 3584 the groove returns with the curved fringes and the same carriers.
